artworks.title: The Corn Snake (Coluber fulvius?)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a snake moving around a plant. The snake has red and grayish-white segments, while the plant has green leaves and a root at the bottom. The color palette includes greens, reds, grays, and browns on a beige background. The snake is coiled in curves from the middle left to the upper right, intertwining with the plant's stem and leaves.

artworks.title: The Guana (Lacerta Iguana)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a large green fruit hanging from a branch, with a lizard crawling over it. Several large green leaves surround the fruit and lizard. The color palette consists of shades of green for the leaves and fruit, and brown tones for the branch and lizard. The lizard is positioned along the branch on the right side, extending diagonally across the image. The fruit hangs prominently in the lower left part of the composition, encircled by the leaves.

artworks.title: The Lyon Lizard (Lacerta 6-lineata)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of an orchid plant with green leaves and a yellow flower. A brown lizard is wrapped around the stem. The color palette includes green, yellow, and brown against a beige background. The roots are visible at the bottom, with the plant stem rising vertically through the center. The lizard is positioned on the lower left, its tail curling around the stem. The flower is located towards the top right, with long petals extending outward.

artworks.title: The Grey Fox Squirrel (Sciurus cinereus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a squirrel next to a branch with flowers. The image shows a side profile of a squirrel with a large, bushy tail, standing on a patch of ground. The squirrel is shaded realistically, with detailed fur. Next to the squirrel, there is a tall plant with oval leaves and multiple orange flowers. Near the squirrel, on the right side of the image, there are two bulbs with roots exposed. The composition focuses on natural and botanical elements, showcasing the interaction between the squirrel and its environment.

artworks.title: The Herd Returning in Stormy Weather (Le troupeau en marche par un temps orageux)
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. A herd of cattle is moving across the terrain, guided by a figure. The horizon is low, showing distant mountains, softly rendered clouds, and a castle-like structure on a hill obscured by trees. On the left, the ruins of an architectural structure, possibly columns, are visible. The etching features detailed brushstrokes, providing texture and depth. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of sepia and dark brown.

artworks.title: The Woodcutter of Rembrandt (Le Bucheron de Rembrandt)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees and a figure in the distance. The scene is depicted with loose brushstrokes, creating a sense of movement. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying shades of brown. The horizon is suggested by converging lines and trees extend diagonally across the composition. In the foreground, there are rocks or a natural outcropping. Beyond, a figure is engaged in an activity.

artworks.title: Farm Children (Les Enfants de la ferme)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with two figures seated on the ground. The horizon is high with trees in the background. The artwork has soft, sketchy brushstrokes and a monochromatic color palette of sepia tones. The figures are surrounded by indistinct vegetation and trees on both sides.

artworks.title: Carte-de-visite with Horseman (La Carte de visite au cavalier)
artworks.description: The image depicts a simple, sketch-like drawing from a side perspective. A faint horizon divides the sky from a barren landscape. On the left is a large scribbled shape, possibly a bush or rock formation. To the right, there is a figure on horseback. The style is hasty and spontaneous, with lines creating a textured effect. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black lines on a cream-colored background.

artworks.title: Shepherd's Bath (Le Bain du berger)
artworks.description: The scene is a landscape with a tranquil waterway, framed by trees. A structure is seen among the trees on a slightly elevated land in the background. The etching depicts dense and dynamic brushstrokes giving a swirling pattern to the foliage and water. The color palette is sepia tones, emphasizing light and shadow contrast. A solitary figure is sitting beside the water, with intricate hatching detailing natural elements. In the distance, outlines of the structure and undulating landscape lead the eye upward in the composition.

artworks.title: Souvenir of Fampoux (Souvenir de Fampoux)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch with clusters of trees in the foreground, leading diagonally towards the middle where a figure is in a boat. The horizon is blended seamlessly with the sketch, using a monochromatic palette of brown and beige. The style employs broad brushstrokes, creating an impressionistic and abstract feel, prioritizing composition over detail and conveying movement and life within the scene.

artworks.title: The Little Sister (La Petite Soeur)
artworks.description: The image shows forms possibly suggesting trees or structures on the low horizon. Three figures are sketched with fluid brushstrokes in a textured style. A small structure to the left and trees on the edge frame the composition.

artworks.title: The Dreamer (Le Songeur)
artworks.description: The image shows a low perspective view looking upwards at a strong, leaning tree arching across the scene towards the right. The horizon is relatively high, above the center line, with rolling hills stretching into the distance. A solitary figure is seated on a rock to the right, looking out at the landscape. The trees and land are depicted with textured brushstrokes, emphasizing details in the bark and foliage. The color palette is primarily sepia tones, creating a warm, monochromatic aesthetic. Light filters through, highlighting parts of the landscape and casting others in shadow.

artworks.title: Young Woman and Death (La Jeune Fille et la Mort)
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch with a scene featuring two figures in a natural setting. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing one figure standing and another crouching. The depiction includes a horizon that is not distinctly defined due to the abstract style of the sketch. Expressive brushstrokes and strong linear elements create a sense of movement. The color scheme is primarily brown, lending a warm tone to the sketch. A detailed tree is prominently featured in the foreground, with its branches extending across the scene. The figures are depicted with expressive lines, suggesting action and dynamism. The contrast between darker strokes and the lighter background adds depth and visual interest to the composition.

artworks.title: Horseman in the Woods, Large Plate (Le Grand Cavalier sous bois)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a rider on horseback traveling along an uneven path. Trees frame the rider on both sides, with loose and expressive brushstrokes giving a textured, sketch-like quality to the foliage and trees. The monochrome color palette is rendered in sepia tones, emphasizing the intricate line work and stippling techniques used to convey depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Gardens of Horace (Les Jardins d'Horace)
artworks.description: The image displays a wooded scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The view is of a clearing or path in a dense forest. The horizon is obscured by foliage, with a brightness suggesting an opening in the trees. Two figures stand under the canopy, providing scale. The brushstrokes are energetic and sketch-like, creating textures of leaves, bark, and groundcover with detail. The color palette consists of sepia and soft browns, giving an antique feel. Background hints at the sky or a distant landscape seen through the trees.

artworks.title: Souvenir of Ostia (Souvenir d'Ostie)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated perspective. In the foreground, there is an expanse of ground with detailed lines indicating grass and earth. Towards the upper third of the composition, there are distant trees and a small building with a domed structure against the sky. The artwork features loose, expressive pen and ink strokes with hatching and cross-hatching techniques for texture. The color palette is monochromatic sepia tones, giving an antique or sketch-like quality. The sky in the background has subtle, light lines hinting at cloud formation.

artworks.title: Luncheon in a Clearing (Un Dejeuner dans la clairiere)
artworks.description: The sketch is drawn from a slightly raised point of view, looking down on a group of people gathered around a table in a wooded setting. The horizon line is not distinctly visible, but a line of trees in the distance separates the sky from the land. The brushstrokes are loose and quick, suggesting the forms of trees and figures without intricate details. The color palette is sepia, creating a warm, monochromatic look accentuating the contrast between dark lines and the off-white paper. In the foreground, there is a fallen object or log, while in the background, people are gathered around a table with thin trees creating a backdrop.

artworks.title: Mary Magdalene Kneeling (Madeleine a genoux)
artworks.description: The sketch shows a full-body view of a seated figure with one raised knee and the other leg bent underneath the body. The person is turned slightly to the side, facing towards the upper right where there is a light source or open space. The head is bowed with loose hair flowing towards the shoulders. The figure appears nude with detailed musculature and texture emphasized through intricate linework. The right arm is raised upward towards the top center of the image. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects held by the figure. The background is textured with horizontal and diagonal lines, giving a dynamic feel to the composition.

artworks.title: Mary Magdalene in Meditation (Madeleine en meditation)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene viewed from an elevated angle looking down at a seated figure. The horizon is high in the composition, emphasizing the sky filled with horizontal lines suggesting clouds. The landscape has undulating lines indicating hills or dunes. The brushstrokes are fluid and sketch-like, with expressive, casual lines creating movement and texture. The color palette is sepia against an off-white background, giving the image a timeless feel. The composition is minimalistic yet expressive, using line texture for depth and interest.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait (Corot par lui-meme)
artworks.description: The image shows a person's head at the center of the composition. The face is depicted with deep shadows and highlights, emphasizing facial features like the brow, nose, and lips. Loose, textured strokes form the person's hair. The background features heavy shading and cross-hatching, creating a dark, abstract energy. Layered lines provide depth around the face. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Hide-and-Seek (Cache-cache)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape sketch viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The scene includes large, vertically oriented trees dominating the right side. The sketch employs fine, detailed strokes and cross-hatching for a textured appearance. The line work varies in boldness to highlight forms, with a monochromatic color palette of various brown shades. In the foreground, there is a figure and a tree blending into the scene, with larger vegetation moving into the distance and a softly sketched sky above.

artworks.title: Hermit's Woods (Le Bois de l'ermite)
artworks.description: The image features a landscape scene with a cluster of trees to the right. The horizon is elevated, with a solitary figure and a structure near the edge of the ridge among the trees. The pen strokes create texture and depth across the image. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia or black ink against a light background, emphasizing textures and shadows. The penwork creates a chiaroscuro effect, highlighting the landscape and tree silhouettes against the sky.

artworks.title: Souvenir of Bas-Breau (Souvenir du Bas-Breau)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a wooded landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is obscured by thick, vertical brushstrokes forming a canopy of trees. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive, creating depth and texture through crosshatching techniques. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia, giving the piece an aged appearance. The scene depicts dense foliage and tree trunks with dappled light filtering through the leaves. The ground is suggested with horizontal strokes leading to darker areas, while in the distance, the image becomes darker and denser with trees and brush converging into a thicket.

artworks.title: Saltarello (Saltarelle)
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures appearing to dance joyfully, with one figure holding a tambourine. The perspective is slightly angled, providing a glimpse into the scene. The background shows tree-like shapes and a building on the left, with a swirling sky above. The image is created using cross-hatching and hatching techniques, giving it a textured look. The color palette is predominantly in sepia tones. Light and shadow add depth and texture to the scene, with the focus on the central figures in a richly textured environment.
